overview: This House resolution assigns Representative Van Epps to two House committees: the Committee on Homeland Security, which oversees the Department of Homeland Security and issues like border and transportation security, and the Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, which oversees federal science agencies such as NASA. Committee assignments decide which members work on which subjects, and the House formally approves them through short resolutions like this one. It does not change any law. The House agreed to it on December 10, 2025.
for: Supporters say routine resolutions like this keep committees fully staffed so the House can do its work.
against: Critics say there is little to object to; the resolution is a procedural step that does not change any law or policy.
